system.description: A neural jack is a small, shallow socket usually mounted in the base of the user’s skull, but it can be installed anywhere near a nerve trunk. A jack allows users to access or operate a device as if it were part of their own bodies. Users experience data received from the device as if they were their own sensory stimuli or memories, allowing them to give movement commands as if they were simple acts of muscular conditioning. Neural jacks allow for bio-digital integration of even the most sophisticated hardware. The jack’s port is used to directly interface with external devices. Operating programs may be part of the device’s software, or the user may run programs stored in their vee. Most electronics and vehicles are equipped with neural control ports, and direct interfacing is accomplished through standardized optical cables. Interfacing through a neural jack provides a +2 bonus to all associated tests. This represents the improved nimbleness, detailed sensory input, and refined control a user gains through mental integration with a device. Since neural jacks eliminate the need for physical action on the part of the user, all actions initiated through a jack are essentially instantaneous. In game terms, this means that a character acting by a jack also receives a +2 bonus to initiative. This bonus is limited to actions conducted through the neural jack, and by the physical capabilities of the device being controlled. Uplink neural jacks—or links—include integrated

system.description: Pain inhibitors, or PIs, are bio-digital switches that do just what their name implies. These relatively simple devices intercept input from pain receptors, eliminating the sensation of pain. PIs are integrated within the neural pathways that deliver impulses to the pain processing centers of the thalamus. When stimulus exceeds preset levels, the implant shunts the excess impulses. This results in the user feeling only minor discomfort, regardless of the level of stimulus. Because pain is an evolutionary adaptation against bodily harm, elimination of the stimulus is inherently dangerous. Therefore, the shunted signal is interfaced with tactile or even auditory centers, that allow the excess nerve impulses to be perceived in an alternate form. This allows the user to sense and react to the magnitude of possible injury without having to deal with the potentially debilitating effects of the pain itself. Learning to gauge the severity of an injury based on this alternate perception requires specific training. Shunting the impulses at the point of the thalamus also eliminates the autonomic responses associated with pain, such as hormone release and metabolic shock. The elimination of incapacitating pain and the body’s physiological responses to it can be a lifesaving advantage. Traumatic injury can be temporarily ignored, allowing the user to perform first aid on themselves, to move to safety, or even to continue fighting after suffering horrendous wounds. Pain

system.description: This relatively simple NIC complex artificially stimulates and inhibits the reticulating activating system of the midbrain, allowing the user to consciously control the mechanisms that prevent and induce sleep. With biofeedback, the user of this biomod can remain awake and alert for up to 60 hours with negligible physiological effects. Subsequently, for each additional 5 hours (or portion thereof) the user remains awake, they suffer a cumulative -1 penalty to all their attributes. With a corollary command, the user can also induce a deep and restful sleep in seconds. This induced sleep is no deeper or longer than normal, the onset is simply immediate. The implant can also be used to bring the sleeper instantly from a state of groggy semiconsciousness to one of immediate alertness, eliminating any potential penalties associated with waking. An internal timer can be set as an alarm clock, waking the user at a specified time.

system.description: Photoskin is an unusual new mod from Biogene, one that may herald an extended series of biomods based on plant, rather than human or animal, DNA. Photoskin involves modifying the user’s skin cells to produce actual chloroplasts, the organelles in plant cells responsible for photosynthesis. The modification enables the transformed cells to use sunlight to convert water and carbon dioxide into carbohydrates. These nutrients are insufficient to sustain human life for an extended period. However, with a sufficient water supply, photoskin can help the user stave off starvation in dire circumstances. Extremely small quantities of food can be rationed out for an extended period of time, with the photoskin providing extra nutrients to compensate for the meager diet. With a combination of the photoskin and anti-poison biomod allowing users to drink salt water, the odds of survival for those stranded in Poseidon’s wilderness are greatly increased. Subjects with the photoskin biomod can be recognized by the slight but noticeable greenish tint of their skin. Transformation Time: 2 weeks
